_readme: Every function this project GRANTs EXECUTE on to `anon` or `authenticated` must
appear here exactly once. A new RPC that is not listed FAILS the build, which is
the whole point: the previous design was a hardcoded JS Set inside
check-rpc-authz.mjs, so a new RPC shipped unguarded by DEFAULT and only a
reviewer noticing could stop it. Now silence is a failure rather than a pass.
Guests sign in anonymously, which makes them `authenticated` — the SAME
PostgREST role staff hold. So for a SECURITY DEFINER function the only thing
between a cafe guest and a privileged body is the guard on its first line.
publicByDesign — a guest may call this. Adding a name here is a security
decision and needs the reason written next to it.
guarded — must refuse an anonymous guest. check-rpc-authz.mjs PROVES this by
calling every one of them as a real guest; it is not taken on trust.
Baseline 2026-09-04: 19 public, 108 guarded, 60 of 127 covered by tests/rls-matrix.ts.

publicByDesign.my_reservations: booking: guarded by reservation OWNERSHIP (guest_id = auth.uid()) inside the body, not by role; a caller who owns nothing matches no row
publicByDesign.cancel_reservation: booking: guarded by reservation OWNERSHIP, not by role
publicByDesign.confirm_booking: booking: guarded by reservation OWNERSHIP, not by role
publicByDesign.create_guest_order: guest ordering: guarded by guest_sessions OWNERSHIP, not by role
publicByDesign.current_venue: 0125/multi-venue: answers WHICH VENUE the caller is already in, from their own station, their own staff_venues rows or the single active venue — it reveals nothing the caller did not supply and grants nothing. It cannot be `guarded`: check-rpc-authz stage 1 requires a FORBIDDEN/AUTH_REQUIRED-shaped refusal from an anonymous guest, and this function either answers or raises VENUE_REQUIRED, which is a question, not a denial. Every write that matters sits behind the column default, not behind this read
publicByDesign.current_venue_or_default: 0125/multi-venue: current_venue with the oldest active venue as a fallback instead of a raise. Granted to anon because the guest menu's pre-identity calls (is_degraded, venue_mode) delegate through it and must never fail on a first page load
publicByDesign.expire_stale_holds: booking: idempotent sweep, safe for any signed-in account to trigger
publicByDesign.has_own_pin: 0087/SEC-34: tells the caller only about the caller — whether THEIR OWN account has an idle-lock PIN. No argument, so it cannot be pointed at another account; false for anyone who is not active staff. Same shape as is_staff / staff_role.
publicByDesign.is_degraded: guest menu, pre-identity: degraded-mode banner. 0137 adds an optional p_venue argument so the banner can name a venue; the zero-arg form falls back to app.current_venue_or_default() and still never raises
publicByDesign.is_own_session: tells the caller only about the caller
publicByDesign.is_staff: tells the caller only about the caller
publicByDesign.is_staff_at: 0123/0139 multi-venue: tells the caller only about the caller — whether THEY hold one of the named roles at the named venue. It cannot be pointed at another account (no staff argument) and is false for anyone who is not active staff there. authenticated only since 0139: no policy or CHECK evaluates it in slice 1 (0136 scopes on staff_venue_ids()), so the anon grant had no reason. Same shape as is_staff
publicByDesign.is_staff_media_path: staff_media_bucket (build-contracts §2.3): pure text — says whether a storage object name is a staff-media path, reads no data and never raises; granted to anon and authenticated because the staff-media policies on storage.objects evaluate it as the reading role (the 0121 trap)
publicByDesign.item_active_groups: guest menu, pre-identity: modifier groups for an item
publicByDesign.menu_availability: guest menu, pre-identity: what is orderable right now
publicByDesign.open_table_session: guest menu, pre-identity: binds a scanned table to a session
publicByDesign.order_is_callers: tells the caller only about the caller
publicByDesign.phone_digits: 0116/S7: pure text (digits folded, nothing else); the profiles_phone_format CHECK evaluates it as the writing role, so every guest must be able to execute it
publicByDesign.price_slot: booking surface: quotes a price before any identity exists
publicByDesign.raise_waiter_call: guest ordering: guarded by guest_sessions OWNERSHIP, not by role
publicByDesign.send_test_push: notifications (0070): targets auth.uid() ONLY — a caller cannot name a profile — rate-limited to one per minute per profile; an account with no Expo token gets NO_PUSH_TOKEN
publicByDesign.staff_media_folder: staff_media_bucket (build-contracts §2.3): pure text — splits the folder segment off a staff-media storage path (NULL for any other name), reads no data and never raises; a storage policy evaluates it as the reading role, so every guest must be able to execute it
publicByDesign.staff_media_venue: staff_media_bucket (build-contracts §2.3): pure text — splits the venue segment off a staff-media storage path (NULL for any other name), reads no data and never raises; a storage policy evaluates it as the reading role, so every guest must be able to execute it
publicByDesign.staff_media_visible: protocols_engine_rpcs (build-contracts §2.3, §2.7): tells the caller only about the caller — whether THEY may read one staff-media object (its uploader, MGMT at its venue, or who the protocol and marketing reads show it to). False for a guest and for any name that is not a staff-media path; it cannot refuse, because the staff_media_read policy on storage.objects evaluates it as the reading role beside menu-media's, and a raise there would break menu photos. authenticated only: that policy is `to authenticated`
publicByDesign.staff_role: tells the caller only about the caller
publicByDesign.staff_venue_ids: 0123/multi-venue: returns the caller's OWN active venue memberships (every active venue for an owner), and nothing about anybody else. It must be granted to anon as well as authenticated because the venue axis in every staff-read policy (0136) calls it, and a function named in a policy is evaluated as the READING role — the 0121 trap. An empty array for a guest
publicByDesign.tab_is_callers: tells the caller only about the caller
publicByDesign.venue_mode: guest menu, pre-identity: open / closed / degraded. 0137 adds an optional p_venue argument for the per-venue answer; the zero-arg form falls back to app.current_venue_or_default() so a first page load cannot fail
publicByDesign.verify_table_token: guest menu, pre-identity: validates a printed QR token
